lines.text: O LORD, God of vengeance,
O God of vengeance, shine forth.
Rise up, O Judge of the earth;
render a reward to the proud.
How long will the wicked, O LORD,
how long will the wicked exult?
They pour out arrogant words;
all workers of iniquity boast.
They crush Your people, O LORD;
they oppress Your heritage.
They kill the widow and the foreigner;
they murder the fatherless.
They say, “The LORD does not see;
the God of Jacob pays no heed.”
Take notice, O senseless among the people!
O fools, when will you be wise?
He who affixed the ear, can He not hear?
He who formed the eye, can He not see?
He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline?
He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?
The LORD knows the thoughts of man,
that they are futile.

pictures.scene: Juan de Valdés Leal, Elijah and the Prophets of Baal — the fire falling on the altar while the prophets of Baal are dragged down at the prophet's word, O LORD God of vengeance shine forth, rise up O Judge of the earth and render a reward to the proud
pictures.name: pd_valdes_wraak

pictures.scene: Gerard van Honthorst, The Mocking of Christ — the grinning men crowding in with the torch and the reed while Christ sits bound under the thorns, how long will the wicked exult, they pour out arrogant words and all workers of iniquity boast
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_hoelang

pictures.scene: Nikolai Yaroshenko, Life Is Everywhere — the prisoners crowded at the barred window of the transport car with the mother holding her child up to scatter crumbs down to the pigeons, they crush Your people O LORD and oppress Your heritage, they kill the widow and the foreigner and murder the fatherless
pictures.name: pd_yaroshenko_verdrukken

pictures.scene: Jan Steen, The Dissolute Household — the whole house drinking and wasting while nobody looks up at the basket of judgments hanging over their heads, they say, the LORD does not see, the God of Jacob pays no heed
pictures.name: pd_steen_zien

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Parable of the Blind — the blind men going down one after another into the ditch with their hands on each other's shoulders, take notice O senseless among the people, O fools when will you be wise
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_dwazen

pictures.scene: Nicolas Colombel, Christ Healing the Blind — Christ reaching out to touch the blind man's eyes with the crowd pressing round, He who affixed the ear can He not hear, He who formed the eye can He not see
pictures.name: pd_colombel_oog

pictures.scene: Albrecht Dürer, Jesus among the Doctors — the boy in the middle of the teachers with their books and their arguing hands, He who admonishes the nations does He not discipline, He who teaches man does He lack knowledge
pictures.name: pd_durer_onderwijst

pictures.scene: Adriaen van Ostade, The Alchemist — the old man blowing at his furnace in a room of broken pots with the hourglass running out over his head, the LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile
pictures.name: pd_ostade_ijdel
